items.description:
Pro Plumb is a PIRB-registered plumbing service provider in Polokwane, established in 2011 and drawing on almost 50 years of combined experience. Its services include burst geysers, blocked drains, drain replacement, leak detection, leaking pipes, solar water heating and gas geysers.

The business also covers storm water systems, fat traps, industrial boilers, septic tanks and French drains, backup water systems and bulk water meters. It handles geyser maintenance, leaking toilets and gutters, commercial plumbing, heat pumps and new developments, along with certificates of compliance and insurance claim work. Customers can call or send a message through the website for fast and reliable service.

Rubberproof Tech does waterproofing and painting of roofs, roof leak repairs and liquid rubber waterproofing for industrial, residential and commercial properties, as well as guest houses and lodges. The business also seals water reservoirs and farm dams, and its listing names membrane waterproofing among its methods.

Since 2015 it has provided liquid rubber waterproofing for roofs and concrete surfaces in Polokwane Central, backed by a 10-year guarantee, alongside related painting and building maintenance work. It suits property owners who need a roof sealed, a leak repaired or a concrete surface protected. The business is at 228 Marshall Street in Polokwane.

Northern Food Distributors is a dry-blending food manufacturer in Futura, Polokwane, producing the Flavour-RITE range of soup powders, gravy powders, powdered desserts, soya mince, instant drinks and spice blends. Its health range includes protein shakes, instant sports drinks and fortified, protein-enriched cereals.

The company says its health products suit hospitals, clinics, community feeding projects and gyms, and that it produces to the highest standard in its facility. It holds ISO 22000:2018 accreditation, and its stated vision is to supply quality, price-effective powder products to suit most markets. The factory is at Polokwane Industrial Park, Lood Street, Futura. The website also lists regional agents for buyers in Gauteng and the North West.

items.description:
Smoochie Kids Salon and Spa is a children's beauty parlour and spa in Bendor Park, offering kids' hairstyling and braids, children's massages and spa packages for one or two children. Its services include hydrotherapy, birthday packages and cornrows, and newborn hydrotherapy is also listed.

Adults can book full-body massages and other spa treatments at the salon, and the team includes massage therapists and hairdressers. The salon says it creates a space where children can fully relax and be pampered as well as get their beauty treatments. The business is at 6 Lottering Street in Bendor Park. Its services are listed online with their durations, so parents can see what each treatment involves before they visit.

items.description:
TC Roof Erectors supplies and fits prefabricated timber roof trusses and roof covering, and the business also offers waterproofing and the painting of walls, ceilings and roofs. Its package includes an A19 certificate and a one-year workmanship guarantee.

The company says its prefabricated timber roof trusses are based on the SANS 10160 and SANS 10163 standards, and it notes that a roof is one of the largest, heaviest and most costly structures in a home, so builders should choose quality over price. Home builders and property owners in Polokwane Central can use the team for trusses, roof covering, waterproofing and painting. The business is based at 102 Market Street.

items.description:
Tysocon Properties is a Polokwane estate agency that offers stylish and comfortable properties for sale and to rent, including stands and townhouses. Its listings cover townhouses for sale, sectional title developments, vacant stands and rental townhouses, and the business describes them as well maintained.

The agency also features estates, complexes and future projects on its website, along with a gallery and a contact page for enquiries about its developments. It has operated from Thornhill Shopping Centre since 1988, according to its listing, and it serves renters and buyers in the area. The office is in Shop 2 on Munnik Avenue in Thornhill.

Vuwa Lodge is a guesthouse in Flora Park, Polokwane, at 7 Cestrum Avenue, offering standard and deluxe rooms that the lodge describes as cosy, charming and comfortable. The rooms feature modern amenities and tasteful decor, and the lodge suits both short stays and longer visits.

The lodge has a licensed bar and restaurant, which serves breakfast, a buffet lunch and buffet dinners made with local and fresh cuisine. Conference facilities and a swimming pool are on site, and a 24-hour front desk looks after guests. The lodge suits business travellers and families who want a peaceful base in Polokwane with a restaurant on the premises.

Avidan (Pty) Ltd is a supplier of residential, engineering, irrigation and plumbing supplies from leading manufacturers, based at 11 Mangaan Street in Superbia. Its product lines include Plasson, Cascade, Duys Tanks and Cobra, and the company is a distributor for the Incledon product ranges.

The company offers a comprehensive supply range for the irrigation and civil construction industry in the area. Its website includes technical information to help customers choose between uPVC and mPVC pipe, and its staff, who have worked in the irrigation and civil industry for some time, will advise on the right product. Customers who are unsure what to use can contact the team for an informed decision.

items.description:
Carpet and Decor's Polokwane branch supplies and installs floor coverings for homes and businesses, including carpets, carpet tiles, laminate, solid wood, luxury vinyl planks and bamboo flooring. The branch also sells blinds and wallpaper, and it offers artificial grass for sale.

The company has been trading since 1968, and its Polokwane team recommends the flooring, window or wall finish best suited to each customer's needs. Staff with years of experience provide product knowledge and technical skills for residential and commercial work, whatever the size of the job. The branch is at 9 Iran Avenue in Superbia. The company's website also has a projects section showing past work, so customers can see the finish before they commit.

items.description:
Elegant Guesthouse has been operating in Moregloed, Polokwane since 2004, with nine private en-suite self-catering rooms that differ in style and features. Room types include king, queen, double and twin or three-quarter bed options, and each has a kitchenette and an en-suite bathroom.

The rooms have television with a DStv hotel package, Netflix and Star TV, according to the guesthouse. The grounds include a shared lounge, a garden and an outdoor pool, and the property offers on-site conference facilities. The guesthouse says it aims to be a home away from home for travellers, and it sleeps up to 34 guests across its rooms, which suits groups and business travellers. It is at 79 Oost Street.

items.description:
Eyecatchers Optometrists in Polokwane Central offers eye examinations, optical solutions, eyewear and contact lens fittings from its branch at the Medpark Medical Centre on Jorissen Street. The branch offers a wide range of modern eyewear, and its team helps customers with frame selection, lens options and fittings.

The practice also provides specialised eye care for children and adults, including screening for common eye conditions, and says its eye exams use the latest technology to be thorough and tailored to each person. Customers can contact the branch by phone or mobile to ask about eye care. The branch is at 24a Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central.

Fishmonger is a Portuguese-style seafood restaurant in Bendor, Polokwane, with a fine-dining focus. Its menu includes prawns, kingklip, fresh sushi options and a signature seafood platter, along with seafood pasta and a haloumi stack for diners who prefer something else.

The restaurant offers cocktails, soft drinks and wines, and a restaurant guide describes a spacious, classy ambiance with an open, inviting interior and friendly, knowledgeable staff. Outdoor seating and on-site parking are available for guests. Its Facebook page presents the restaurant as a Mediterranean-style spot with Portuguese-style dishes, and it has an Instagram presence for guests to follow. The restaurant is at 7 Pierre Street in Bendor, Polokwane.

items.description:
Jacaranda Lodge is a 38-room guesthouse on Voortrekker Street in Polokwane Central, offering luxury and standard en-suite rooms, family rooms and self-catering units. The lodge describes itself as a comfortable business and family-friendly environment with warm hospitality and professional service.

Security is provided around the clock with electric fencing, and parking is covered. Guests have free Wi-Fi and access to a dining hall, and the lodge has conference facilities for meetings and events. The lodge has a 4.3 rating from 16 reviews on LekkeSlaap, and it suits both business travellers and families. Its listing shows standard rooms, family rooms, self-catering units and luxury family rooms, so guests can choose the type of stay they need.

Limpopo Power Steering repairs and supplies steering racks, boxes and pumps for cars, bakkies and trucks, and it stocks electronic power steering units for modern vehicles. The business grew out of a workshop called CV World, which started offering steering repairs in 1991.

Its units come with a 12-month unlimited-kilometre guarantee, which the business says matches manufacturers' guarantees on original equipment. Exchange units are available for popular makes to cut down turnaround time, and the business offers a free vehicle inspection and advice with no obligation. The website describes repair and supply for all vehicles, bakkies and trucks, so a driver with a steering fault can bring in any of those vehicles. The business is at 1 Diamant Street in Futura.

items.description:
Mabule's Residence is a self-catering residence in Turfloop, Mankweng, providing safe and affordable accommodation for University of Limpopo students and young working people. The residence has 24-hour security, free Wi-Fi and parking, and it is at Stand 233, Unit E, Peter Mokaba in Turfloop.

The business says demand for student accommodation has grown as more young people move to Polokwane to study, so it has acquired more properties to meet that need. Its values focus on community and co-operation, and tenants agree to house rules that protect shared property and privacy. Some former students stay on the premises after they finish their studies.

items.description:
Mphela and Associates Attorneys is a law firm with offices in Polokwane, Groblersdal and Pretoria, previously trading under a different name. Its core business is personal injury and general litigation, and its About page describes a wholly Black-owned practice with a collective post-admission experience of 51 years between its directors and associates.

The firm's services also include criminal, labour, family and general civil litigation, along with conveyancing. Its attorneys and skilled negotiators support clients through difficult times, and the firm offers a free case evaluation for injury claims, with fees payable only if the client wins (no win, no fee). Its Polokwane Central office is at RS Chambers, 30A Bodenstein Street.
